title: Canonical assertion (DRAFT by Thesis B, 14 Nov 2026, to be confirmed by Thesis A)
description: One full proposition in schema-neutral canonical form, as Thesis A's technique defines it in prose (Eval 2 package v0.1, section 1.2): subject, predicate, object, qualifiers (scope, validity time, condition or exception, modality, priority) and provenance (anchor into a source unit plus authority record). The shared validator checks this object (common scope, agreement 3.2). This file is Thesis B's machine-readable reading of the prose; Thesis A owns the canonical form and confirms or corrects it before the freeze on 23 Nov. Additional fields are allowed everywhere.

assertion_id.description: id in the export; null before the write

item_id.description: the fact candidate's item_id of the log (shared-minimum-log/1)

predicate.description: surface predicate as written; CS-02 maps it to the canonical vocabulary through the equivalence table

qualifiers.description: every key optional; absent or null means the source documents no such qualifier

scope.description: jurisdiction or institution the proposition holds for

priority.description: where a source documents one (e.g. override order)

unit_id.description: the source unit the agent was processing (sample manifest)

source_id.description: the source file the unit was cut from

locator.description: anchor inside the unit: section, row, cell, character range

entity_ref.description: a reference to an entity by id and/or by surface label with a type

id.description: graph element id when known (existing entity); null for a new entity

label.description: surface name as written in the source

type.description: surface type as written; CS-02 maps it through the equivalence table

unit.description: unit symbol for quantities; CS-04 checks it against the unit list
